findings.title: An MCP elicitation is collapsed into a tool failure and never reaches the operator
findings.recommendation: In SessionEffects#mcp_payload give :interrupt its own branch that reaches the step gate via the existing Tamoz.interrupt seam (graph/interrupt.rb:51) instead of raising ToolError, then route the answer through the already-existing but dead Invocation.reissue using the descriptor's effect_key. If full MRTR is out of scope, make :interrupt terminal and operator-visible rather than repairable so the run stops with the server's question instead of looping.

findings.title: Server-authored tool descriptions reach the planner prompt verbatim and unmarked
findings.recommendation: In SessionEffects#mcp_planning_surface prefix each remote description with the same 'remote content from server <id>' attribution Invocation already applies to result blocks (invocation.rb:32, :640-641), so merge_tool_surfaces keeps its shape and the prompt distinguishes remote from local text. Add one assertion to test/agent_mcp_capability_source_test.rb.

findings.title: Invocation and the capability binding read different fields of the same duck-typed descriptor with no agreement guard
findings.recommendation: Pick one authoritative reader: either add :read_only? to REQUIRED_DESCRIPTOR_METHODS (invocation.rb:37), or have Invocation derive its branch from effect_class when the descriptor responds to it, matching McpCapabilitySource#read_only_descriptor? which already prefers read_only?. State the choice in the duck-type comment at mcp_source_builder.rb:28-31 and add the one-line assertion to test/mcp_invocation_test.rb.

findings.title: stdio frame bound (4 MiB SDK default) is 64x the configured output budget
findings.recommendation: Optionally pass max_line_bytes: config.budgets.max_output_bytes at supervisor.rb:174-178 so both transports enforce the configured budget. No action required.

carried_forward.note: Verified against current source, unchanged. The half in tamoz-mcp is narrow and not a defect: the gem supplies catalog/descriptors/source_digest but makes no admission decision and has no profile concept. The other half lives in tamoz-agent-capabilities: CapabilityBinding#admission_set (capability_binding.rb:161-169) appends every @mcp.names beside the profile-derived @toolbox.allowed_tools, and McpSourceBuilder builds without consulting a profile (mcp_source_builder.rb:50-69; cli.rb:650 uses its profile: argument only for a workspace-root comparison). New datum: the binding's own comment at capability_binding.rb:157-162 calls the set policy-derived and claims Toolbox#allowed_tools is already profile-intersected, while the same expression unconditionally appends @mcp.names.

DEAD confirmed fixed (strict_schema at invocation.rb:239-241 delegates wholly to deep_strictify). SIZE confirmed open: call 7 params (:84), reissue 10 (:108), round_trip 8 keywords (:358). FX confirmed open: resume_tool still uses client.send(:request, ...) at :427.
server_config.rb validator breadth unchanged; no new defect found. describe (:158-175) exposes env/credential names only, never values.

PASS upheld. FX question answered affirmatively: no raw MCP call site exists inside a graph node. Invocation's only production caller is the executor lambda at mcp_source_builder.rb:120, reached exclusively via McpCapabilitySource#execute -> McpDispatcher#execute -> CapabilityBinding#execute -> SessionEffects#execute_dispatch inside EffectDispatcher.run. Catalog.compile (mcp_source_builder.rb:73) and Supervisor.build (:75) are admission-time, run once per runtime at worker_runtime.rb:919-923 outside graph execution, and are pinned by digest rather than journaled.
